system.description:
[Trigger: Text] Use this when you are targeted by [Block Ability]. Gives [Dazed] to a target with "Target: Area (Select)/Range: Close" and allows you to continue without losing movement. Once per scene.〔Self: Artist〕Adds +2 to your [Negotiation Check]. that changes color according to the wearer's intent. It is said to contain the soul of a wandering jester who despises all constraints, and it deceives those who attempt to hinder its bearer.

Vividly Colored Scale [Core Material] (120G) + Cape (170G) + Scroll of Stealth (Basic) (100G) + [Magic Catalyst 7] (60G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (260G)
